events.strDescriptionEN:
The Maybank Championship is a women's professional golf tournament hosted annually in Malaysia as part of the LPGA Tour fall Asian swing. Played at the prestigious Kuala Lumpur Golf & Country Club (KLGCC) West Course, the tournament features a $3 million purse with a $450,000 winner's share.
The latest edition concluded 1 November 2026, where world No. 4 Miyu Yamashita made history by becoming the tournament's first back-to-back champion.
Yamashita shot a final-round 68 to finish at 22-under-par 266, holding off a fierce challenge from China's Yan Liu to secure a two-stroke victory. Frenchwoman Pauline Roussin-Bouchard and Thai amateur Marisa Tojai shared third place.
